question: Which of the following is the autobiography of Bhishma Sahni?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aaj ke Ateet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aaj ke Ateet** is the autobiography of **Bhishma Sahni**, a renowned Indian writer and playwright.
 
• Bhishma Sahni is widely celebrated for his contributions to Hindi literature, particularly for his novel **Tamas**, which depicts the violence and trauma of the partition of India.
 
• **Aaj ke Ateet** translates to **"Today's Past"**, offering a personal and historical insight into Sahni's life experiences.
 
• The autobiography sheds light on Sahni's literary journey, his ideological beliefs, and his engagement with the socio-political issues of his time.
 
• It is a significant work that helps readers understand the life and thoughts of one of India's literary stalwarts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhishma Sahni**:

 
 
• Born on August 8, 1915, in Rawalpindi, now in Pakistan.
 
• He was a prominent Hindi writer, playwright, and actor, contributing significantly to Indian literature.
 
• His notable works include **Tamas**, **Basanti**, and **Jharokhe**.
 
• He was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1975 and the Padma Bhushan in 1998.
 
 
 
• **Tamas**:
 
 
• A novel by Bhishma Sahni published in 1974, based on the partition of India in 1947.
 
• It was adapted into a television series directed by Govind Nihalani in 1986.
 
• The novel explores the communal violence and human suffering during the partition.
 
 
 
• **Hindi Literature**:
 
 
• It encompasses a rich tradition of poetry, fiction, and drama.
 
• Key figures include Premchand, Harivansh Rai Bachchan, and Mahadevi Verma.
 
• It addresses various themes such as social issues, patriotism, and human emotions.
 
 
 
• **Autobiography**:
 
 
• A literary genre where an individual writes about their own life.
 
• Provides personal insight and historical context.
 
• Famous autobiographies include **The Diary of a Young Girl** by Anne Frank and **Long Walk to Freedom** by Nelson Mandela.
